[`render_receipt`](<fixture>/receipt.py:1) takes an item count and subtotal in cents. It adds 175 cents when there is at least one item, then formats the total as `N items: $D.CC` ([receipt.py](<fixture>/receipt.py:2)).

Its direct caller is [`checkout`](<fixture>/checkout.py:4), which passes the number of prices and their sum to `render_receipt` ([checkout.py](<fixture>/checkout.py:5)).
